title: MXL Fabric
description: Fabric ports, links and mirror placement of mxl-k8s: what placement committed per port against the ceilings in force, what the links carry, link health, and per-mirror delivery.

panels.title: Links down
panels.description: Fabric links whose netdev, or RDMA port where there is no netdev, is not up.

panels.title: Wire receive
panels.description: Bits per second received on every selected link. Source per link: the 802.3 MAC octets where the driver reports them, otherwise the larger of the RDMA port and netdev counts.

targets.expr: sum(8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Wire transmit
panels.description: Bits per second transmitted on every selected link, sourced as Wire receive.

targets.expr: sum(8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Hottest port vs ceiling
panels.description: Highest committed demand on any port and direction over that port's plannable capacity (capacity times the node's maximum utilization). Above 100% placement has committed past the ceiling.

panels.title: Hottest link on the wire
panels.description: Highest wire rate on any selected link and direction over its link speed.

targets.expr: max(label_replace((8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval])))) / on(node, link) mxl_gateway_link_speed_bits_per_second{node=~"$node",link=~"$link"}, "direction", "ingress", "", "") or label_replace((8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval])))) / on(node, link) mxl_gateway_link_speed_bits_per_second{node=~"$node",link=~"$link"}, "direction", "egress", "", ""))

panels.title: Link errors
panels.description: Error and drop counters of the selected links, per second, every source summed.

panels.title: Overcommitted mirrors
panels.description: Mirrors placed on a pair without room: their Placed reason is Overcommitted.

panels.title: Held mirrors
panels.description: Mirrors left unplaced and not set up because no pair has room (--placement-overcommit=hold).

panels.title: Unplaced mirrors
panels.description: Mirrors waiting for their flow's rate (AwaitingDemand) or without an interface pair (NoInterface).

panels.title: Mirrors not Ready
panels.description: MxlFlowMirrors in any phase other than Ready.

panels.title: Sets sharing a port
panels.description: MxlFlowRedundancySets whose member mirrors to one node share a fabric port.

panels.title: Placement p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time from a mirror's creation to its placement.

panels.title: Default ceiling
panels.description: --placement-max-utilization: the share of a capacity placement commits on nodes that set none of their own.

panels.title: Protocol overhead
panels.description: --placement-protocol-overhead: added to a flow's published rate when it is charged.

panels.title: Provisional demand
panels.description: --placement-provisional-demand: charged for a flow that has not published its rate within the demand wait.

panels.title: Demand wait
panels.description: --placement-demand-wait.

panels.title: Overcommit / pairing
panels.description: --placement-overcommit (place: overcommitted mirrors are placed and reported; hold: they are left unplaced) and --placement-pairing.

panels.title: Effective ceiling per node
panels.description: The share of capacity placement commits on each node: the node's own (its gateway's --fabric-max-utilization) or the operator default.

panels.title: Gateway settings per variant
panels.description: What each node's gateway publishes: its own ceiling (absent where it leaves it to the operator) and its shared budgets. Variant is the gateway DaemonSet variant.

panels.title: Shared budgets
panels.description: Budgets the gateways publish, per node, with the plannable share and the committed load per direction. A budget's mode says which directions count against it.

panels.title: Committed vs plannable vs capacity
panels.description: Per port and direction: demand placed (solid), plannable capacity (capacity times the node's ceiling, dashed) and capacity (dotted). A port is the device the provider names, or the address where it names none. Capacity is the same in both directions.

panels.title: Committed share of capacity
panels.description: Committed demand over capacity per port and direction, with each port's ceiling (dashed). Above its ceiling a port carries overcommitted mirrors.

panels.title: Ports against their ceiling
panels.description: Committed demand over plannable capacity per port and direction, highest first. Above 100% the port is over its ceiling.

targets.expr: max by (node, port, direction) (mxl_operator_port_committed_bits_per_second{node=~"$node",port=~"$port",direction=~"$direction"} / on(node, port) group_left mxl_operator_port_plannable_bits_per_second{node=~"$node",port=~"$port"})

panels.title: Mirrors not placed cleanly
panels.description: Mirrors placed past a ceiling (Overcommitted), held back (Held), waiting for their flow's rate (AwaitingDemand) or without an interface pair (NoInterface).

targets.expr: max by (namespace, mirror, flow_id, source_node, source_port, target_node, target_port, provider, placement, phase) (mxl_operator_mirror_placement_info{placement=~"Overcommitted|Held|AwaitingDemand|NoInterface",source_node=~"$node"} or mxl_operator_mirror_placement_info{placement=~"Overcommitted|Held|AwaitingDemand|NoInterface",target_node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Mirrors per link: planned vs bound
panels.description: Mirrors the operator placed on the ports of each link (solid) against the mirrors the gateway has bound there (dashed). A gap persists where a gateway bound an interface before a placement existed, or while one is being set up.

targets.expr: sum by (node, link, direction) (mxl_operator_port_mirrors{node=~"$node",port=~"$port",direction=~"$direction"} * on(node, port) group_left(link) max by (node, port, link) (mxl_gateway_fabric_port_info{node=~"$node",link=~"$link"}))

sum by (node, link, direction) (mxl_gateway_interface_mirrors{node=~"$node",direction=~"$direction"} * on(node, interface) group_left(link) label_replace(max by (node, address, link) (mxl_gateway_fabric_port_info{node=~"$node",link=~"$link"}), "interface", "$1", "address", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Shared budgets
panels.description: Committed load on each shared budget per direction (solid) against its plannable share (dashed).

panels.title: Wire receive per link
panels.description: Bits per second received per link: the 802.3 MAC octets where the driver reports them, otherwise the larger of the RDMA port count and the netdev count, a lower bound.

targets.expr: 8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Wire transmit per link
panels.description: Bits per second transmitted per link, sourced as Wire receive per link.

targets.expr: 8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Wire per node
panels.description: Every selected link of a node summed, per direction.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval]))))

sum by (node) (8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Wire share of link speed
panels.description: Wire rate over link speed per link and direction.

targets.expr: (8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval])))) / on(node, link) mxl_gateway_link_speed_bits_per_second{node=~"$node",link=~"$link"}

(8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval])))) / on(node, link) mxl_gateway_link_speed_bits_per_second{node=~"$node",link=~"$link"}

panels.title: Bytes by source
panels.description: Each kernel source on its own: mac (802.3 MAC octets, the whole wire), rdma (RDMA port data, RDMA traffic only), netdev (kernel interface statistics; whether RDMA is included depends on the driver). Receive above the axis, transmit below.

panels.title: Wire against mirror payload
panels.description: Wire rate per node (solid) against the payload the node's mirrors moved (dashed). The difference is protocol framing and traffic the gateway does not carry.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_transmitted_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval]))))

sum by (node) (8 * (sum by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source="mac"}[$__rate_interval])) or max by (node, link) (rate(mxl_gateway_link_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node",link=~"$link",source=~"rdma|netdev"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Link state
panels.description: Up per link: the netdev's operstate, or the RDMA port's state where there is no netdev.

panels.title: Link speed and carrier changes
panels.description: Link speed (left) and carrier changes or RDMA link_downed events per interval (bars, right).

panels.title: Errors and drops
panels.description: Error and drop counters per link, by source and the kernel's name for the counter.

panels.title: Errors in range
panels.description: Error and drop counters that moved within the selected time range.

panels.title: Pause frames
panels.description: 802.3x pause frames per link: egress sent (this port asked its peer to stop), ingress received. Per-priority flow control is not included.

panels.title: Transmit wait
panels.description: Ticks per second an RDMA port had data to send and sent none (port_xmit_wait). A rising rate means the port is held back by its peer or the fabric.

panels.title: Read invalid at the source
panels.description: Units the gateway read that the ring held invalid or incomplete, over the units it read: grains the writer did not complete. Grains inside a jump to the head are not read and not in this.

panels.title: Skipped at the source
panels.description: Skipped units over the units read or skipped, in the range. Skipped units were jumped over to reach the head again: the loop trailed the head, or the slot was reused before it was read. The gateway does not read them, so a resync over grains the writer skipped counts here too.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(mxl_gateway_source_skipped_total{node=~"$node"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(increase(mxl_gateway_source_skipped_total{node=~"$node"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(mxl_gateway_source_reads_total{node=~"$node",result=~"ok|invalid|incomplete|missing"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Writer late at the source
panels.description: Grains the gateway still waited for a grace period (one grain, or one batch of samples, plus 50 ms) after their media timestamp, in the range: the writer's lateness.

panels.title: Target commit failures
panels.description: Commits on the target that failed, in the range.

panels.title: Source units by outcome
panels.description: What the mirrors' source handles counted per second: read complete, read invalid, and skipped. Skipped units were jumped over to reach the head again: the loop trailed the head, or the slot was reused before it was read. The gateway does not read them, so a resync over grains the writer skipped counts here too.

panels.title: Target writes
panels.description: Commits on the target per second by result, and arrivals committed invalid by issue: invalid from the source, missing where a later write overtook the slot.

panels.title: Units per mirror
panels.description: Units per mirror over the time range. flow is the mirror, as <namespace>/<name>; read and skipped come from its source node, written from its target node. Skipped units were jumped over to reach the head again: the loop trailed the head, or the slot was reused before it was read. The gateway does not read them, so a resync over grains the writer skipped counts here too.

panels.title: Source arrival and target commit latency (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of when the gateway read a unit at the source, and committed it at the target, after its media timestamp. The difference is what the fabric and the target add.

panels.title: Writer late at the source per mirror
panels.description: Grains the gateway still waited for a grace period after their media timestamp, per mirror: the writer's lateness, not the fabric's.

panels.title: Mirror placement
panels.description: Every mirror with its ports, Placed reason and phase. Ports are named as on the port panels. The flow id links to the flow dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, mirror, flow_id, source_node, source_port, target_node, target_port, provider, placement, phase) (mxl_operator_mirror_placement_info{flow_id=~"$flow",source_node=~"$node"} or mxl_operator_mirror_placement_info{flow_id=~"$flow",target_node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Delivered vs demand per mirror
panels.description: Payload committed on the target per mirror over the demand placement charged it. Demand includes the protocol overhead, and a data flow's rate is an upper bound, so a fully delivered flow reads somewhat below 100%. Mirrors of one flow between the same two nodes are summed on both sides.

targets.expr: (8 * sum by (domain, flow_id, source_node, target_node) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(mxl_gateway_mirror_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]), "target_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "source_node", "$1", "peer_node", "(.*)"))) / on(domain, flow_id, source_node, target_node) (sum by (domain, flow_id, source_node, target_node) (mxl_operator_mirror_demand_bits_per_second{target_node=~"$node",flow_id=~"$flow"}))

panels.title: Delivered per mirror
panels.description: Payload committed on the target per mirror (solid) and the demand charged (dashed).

targets.expr: 8 * sum by (domain, flow_id, source_node, target_node) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(mxl_gateway_mirror_received_bytes_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]), "target_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "source_node", "$1", "peer_node", "(.*)")) and on(domain, flow_id, source_node, target_node) (sum by (domain, flow_id, source_node, target_node) (mxl_operator_mirror_demand_bits_per_second{target_node=~"$node",flow_id=~"$flow"}))

panels.title: Late and lost transfers
panels.description: Transfers per second that completed after their grain or batch interval (late) or were outstanding when a target was given up (lost), per mirror source.

panels.title: Completion lag
panels.description: Grains between the source head and the last grain completed to the target, per mirror.

panels.title: Path disjointness
panels.description: Whether the member mirrors of each MxlFlowRedundancySet arriving on one node use separate fabric ports, with the reason the operator gives.

panels.title: Disjointness over time
panels.description: Path disjointness per redundancy set.

panels.title: Placement latency
panels.description: Time from a mirror's creation to its first placement, by percentile.

panels.title: Placements
panels.description: First placements per minute.

panels.title: Mirrors by Placed reason
panels.description: MxlFlowMirrors by the reason of their Placed condition.

panels.title: Mirrors by phase
panels.description: MxlFlowMirrors by phase.
